Subject: Close Sentinel: Verify stage integrity before finance snapshot

Team —

Quick finance heads-up: we have a scheduled revenue snapshot on Friday (2026-04-10) for the May close cycle. Before that runs, we need a short hygiene pass to ensure our committed numbers are defensible. I pulled a CSV of deals that haven't had a stage or close-date change in the past 14 days (attached: stale-opps-extract.csv).

Please do the following by EOD Thursday 2026-04-08:
- Review deals in the report assigned to you and either: update stage/close date, move to Hold/Archive, or add a one-line evidence note in the SF opportunity (who said what/when).
- If you believe a deal should stay in Commit but needs finance evidence, attach a brief PDF to the opp (pricing email, signed TOA, scheduled PO, etc.).
- If you need help with wording or to escalate, reply to this thread and tag Neha (finance) — she will validate evidence.

Quick filters to use in SFDC (saved report): https://redwood.lightning.force.com/00O5g00000ReportId
An example one-line evidence note: "Client confirmed PO sent 2026-03-29; expected bank transfer by 2026-04-05 (contact: ops@nexahealth.com)."

Goals: reduce aging Commit items, minimize surprise write-downs, and give finance confidence for snapshot. This is a short triage — conservative wins here.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for flagging OPP-76421 (NexaHealth). Do this: reach out to ops@nexahealth.com now with the short template below, copy the SF owner, and upload any reply as a PDF to the opp. If they confirm a binding PO date, keep in Commit and attach the evidence. If they hedge, move to Best Case and include the one-line reason in the opp notes.

Suggested outreach (keep <2 sentences):
Hi (name),
Quick question — can you confirm whether the PO for Redwood (SOW #RDW-76421) is scheduled for payment in April? We need a firm intent/date to include in our finance snapshot. Reply here or copy accounting@redwood.com — thanks.

Neha — if Ben gets a reply that looks like a payment timeline but isn’t a PO, can you confirm whether that is sufficient for finance to accept as Commit?

If folks run into stalled responses, mark the opp Best Case and add a short rationale — we'll exclude from the committed snapshot if it lacks evidence.

Marissa
